| Name                | Type     | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `endpoint`          | `string` |          | `''`    | The app path of the shipped ledger (`/apps/&lt;app&gt;/api/starter/shipped`); empty shows no ledger.                                                                 |
| `setsUrl`           | `string` |          | `''`    | An app path that lists the loaded sets, `{ sets: [{ id, label }] }` (`/apps/&lt;app&gt;/api/setup/example-sets`); empty shows no list.                               |

| `removeSetQuestion` | `string` |          | `''`    | The question asked before a removal, `{set}` filled in. Defaults to a sentence on what goes.                                                                         |
| `schemas`           | `array`  |          | `[]`    | The schemas to show, `[{ slug, label }]`; the first is shown first.                                                                                                  |
| `countUrl`          | `string` |          | `''`    | An app path that counts a schema's objects, `{schema}` filled in (`/apps/openregister/api/objects/&lt;register&gt;/{schema}`), read with `_limit=1` for its `total`. |
